id: \bThink you can keep up?
en: \bThink you can keep up?
it: \bPensi di riuscire a starmi dietro?

id: \bWell I guess I lost. Oh well.
en: \bWell I guess I lost. Oh well.
it: \bBeh, a quanto pare ho perso. Pazienza.

id: \bFlannery uses Fire type Pokémon. They are weak against the Water, Ground, and Rock types.
en: \bFlannery uses Fire type Pokémon. They are weak against the Water, Ground, and Rock types.
it: \bFiammetta usa Pokémon di tipo Fuoco. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Terra e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, Ice, and Steel. Bug, Grass, Fire, Ice, Steel, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, Ice, and Steel.  Bug, Grass, Fire, Ice, Steel, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Coleottero, Erba, Ghiaccio e Acciaio.  Anche le mosse di tipo Coleottero, Erba, Fuoco, Ghiaccio, Acciaio e Folletto non fanno molti danni.

id: \bBoy is it hot in here.
en: \bBoy is it hot in here.
it: \bAccidenti, che caldo che fa qui dentro.

id: \bI need to cool down.
en: \bI need to cool down.
it: \bDevo rinfrescarmi.

id: \bDon't complain if you lose.
en: \bDon't complain if you lose.
it: \bNon lamentarti se perdi.

id: \bYou're stronger than I thought.
en: \bYou're stronger than I thought.
it: \bSei più forte di quanto pensassi.

id: \bShow me your fiery passion.
en: \bShow me your fiery passion.
it: \bMostrami la tua passione ardente.

id: \bOh so fiery.
en: \bOh so fiery.
it: \bOh, che ardore.

id: \rFlannery: Welcome to my grandfather's...No wait, welcome to my Gym.
en: \rFlannery: Welcome to my grandfather's...No wait, welcome to my Gym.
it: \rFiammetta: Benvenuto nella Palestra di mio nonno... No, aspetta, benvenuto nella mia Palestra.

id: \rDare not underestime me...No wait, I am Flannery, the Gym Leader.
en: \rDare not underestime me...No wait, I am Flannery, the Gym Leader.
it: \rNon osare sottovalutarmi... No, aspetta, io sono Fiammetta, la Capopalestra.

id: \r...I'm new at this but I'm not easy alright. Let's just get started.
en: \r...I'm new at this but I'm not easy alright. Let's just get started.
it: \r...Sono nuova del mestiere, ma non sono un osso facile, chiaro? Cominciamo e basta.

id: \rFlannery: You've earned the Heat Badge.
en: \rFlannery: You've earned the Heat Badge.
it: \rFiammetta: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Caldo.

id: \rHere, have this TM too.
en: \rHere, have this TM too.
it: \rEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \rTM50 contains Overheat. It's powerful but lowers your Special Attack, so use it cautiously.
en: \rTM50 contains Overheat. It's powerful but lowers your Special Attack, so use it cautiously.
it: \rLa MT50 contiene Vampata. È potente, ma riduce il tuo Attacco Speciale, quindi usala con cautela.

id: \rYou're really strong. Norman in Petalburg might be a good match for you.
en: \rYou're really strong. Norman in Petalburg might be a good match for you.
it: \rSei davvero forte. Norman di Petalipoli potrebbe essere un avversario alla tua altezza.

id: \rFlannery: Come by later. I'm sure I'll be even better at this.
en: \rFlannery: Come by later. I'm sure I'll be even better at this.
it: \rFiammetta: Ripassa più tardi. Sono sicura che diventerò ancora più brava in questo.

id: \rDon't think this will be easy.
en: \rDon't think this will be easy.
it: \rNon credere che sarà facile.

id: \rI wonder if it was just luck.
en: \rI wonder if it was just luck.
it: \rMi chiedo se sia stata solo fortuna.
